method: read-only grep sweep over sibling lanes (*-shokunin)/{corpus/knowledge,SKILL.md,tools} for rev=, receipt, attestation, provenance, digest, frozen receipt; every rule-bearing hit verified committed at HEAD and five neighbour gates executed on the two real receipts the lane accepted

c2_subject.relation: receipt -> the revision the lane certifies it for

hits.head: 9eef15e7c0e0
hits.owns: receipt header names tool-rev + tool path + optional digest; revision must resolve, be ancestor of tip, and the tool blob at tip must equal the blob at that revision
hits.why: subject is the tool revision; header form is not rev=, so on both real receipts it prints RECEIPT_NO_REV and never reaches C2's defect

hits.head: 44f76d456c1b
hits.owns: stamped == evaluated == measured revision, tree hash of stamped, counter sha256; --topo carrier parentage; --lands reads committed bytes
hits.why: binds a receipt to its own run, not to the revision the lane certifies; on both real receipts FAIL missing_headers

hits.head: 0242085909fb
hits.owns: receipt v1 header binds rev + tool + tool_sha256 + cmd + rc; verify refuses RECEIPT-TOOL-DIGEST-MISMATCH; every quoted count needs such a receipt
hits.why: subject is tool bytes at the named revision; does not ask whether that revision is the certified one; on the round-54 receipt RECEIPT-MALFORMED

hits.head: 7ee8cbdf160f
hits.owns: gate receipts record argv, source and evaluated revisions, gate/runner digests, numeric exit, stdout/stderr; audit replays each case from its pinned source revision
hits.why: scoped to kama's own fixture replay; does not gate a round's control/verdict receipts against the certification revision

hits.head: b866a1d3d266
hits.owns: a revision-cited gate/measurement is admissible only with a committed receipt whose header names that revision and the tool digest; the checker enforces the citation leg over a report
hits.why: citation side, not acceptance side; on a tameshi lesson it reports cited=0

hits.head: b866a1d3d266
hits.owns: binds a gate's --revision CLI input to a landed commit (branch, resolution, ancestry, pushed-ness); E-REVISION-NOT-LANDED etc.
hits.why: input revision of a tool; no receipt is read

hits.head: 1a48131577ba
hits.owns: a measurement receipt names the revision it measured and the sha256 of every tool it depends on; every revision a record names as measured has a committed receipt naming it
hits.why: record-side presence and digest identity (revision -> receipt); witness is a fixed round-30 instrument, not a later-round gate

hits.head: 1a48131577ba
hits.owns: receipt -> the invocation that wrote it: counterSha256, toolSha256, three defect classes (counter-error receipt, missing tool, planted earlier run)
hits.why: binds a receipt to a run, not to the revision it is evidence for

hits.head: 9eef15e7c0e0
hits.owns: r38: gate_sha256_pre/post + counter identity, measured by the counter; r31: a claim carries a sha256 pin over exact source bytes (CLAIM_SOURCE_REVISION_MISMATCH)
hits.why: byte binding of the gate under test; content pin on a claim's source; neither is a receipt->certified-revision rule

hits.head: dc73587a8b9c
hits.owns: receipt digests, pins, mid-run drift, mid maps; 32 selftest cases
hits.why: integrity of a run's own record; no revision comparison

hits.head: 69b61db46be4
hits.owns: replays a pinned rearmed receipt; --observe writes a new receipt and returns RECEIPT-MISMATCH on drift; scope sentence: receipts bind bytes, never provider attestation
hits.why: observed-vs-pinned comparison inside one tool; the scope sentence is a limit C2 should keep

hits.head: 14057f3e3899
hits.owns: canonical-JSON record digest as receipt identity, sha256sum text-mode sidecar, nonce ledger whose evidence set is the whole directory; VALID/REPLAY/TAMPERED/UNREADABLE/USAGE
hits.why: grep -n -iE 'revision|commit' scripts/receipt-attest.mjs prints 0 hits: no revision axis

hits.head: 6defe31e4af9
hits.owns: digest equality holds only over the exact bytes hashed; reformatting invalidates a digest claim
hits.why: supplies the semantics of C2's content-identity escape and warns a digest leg is not behaviour

hits.head: 89dd182b7094
hits.owns: pin + byte-identity + install receipts for an MCP tree, with the provenance file's own sha256

hits.head: 7ee8cbdf160f
hits.owns: capture provenance declared as git show <pinned-commit>:<path>, corroborated by git cat-file blob; a live receipt's provenance admitted only when each digest is bound to the artifact the same run used
hits.why: provenance of a capture, record-time verification; adjacent subject

gate_comparison.reading: every sibling gate refuses for a different reason than C2's; none reaches the two-token / certified-revision defect

must_report_not_absorb.why: C2 reads no tool path and has no tip comparison
C2 deliberately permits rev= != certified on byte-identical declared paths; the content-identity escape must be scoped to the certification relation only or the two rules read as contradictions

must_report_not_absorb.owner: souji Q55, chousa r38, kake, kumitate
must_report_not_absorb.leg: digest of tool/counter/gate bytes and canonical record identity
must_report_not_absorb.why: C2's RECEIPT_DIGEST_MISMATCH reads an optional sidecar beside the receipt, not tool digests
converse direction: C2 gates receipts the lane accepts, not claims a record makes
C2 has no topology leg; RECEIPT_CONTROL_NOT_ANCESTOR is revision ancestry, not carrier parentage

naming_risk.action: the C2 knowledge entry should name chousa QUALITY 84 once as the tool-revision neighbour

verdict_line: overlap=complement — six sibling lanes bind receipts to tool revision / stamp==evaluation / tool bytes / citation / carrier parentage; five more lanes own provenance or identity gates; none owns the certification relation, and each neighbour gate refuses the two real receipts for a different reason than C2's
limits: grep-led discovery over three roots per lane; rules stated only in lessons/PROVINCE/SHONEN or wave reports are reached only when they also land in a criterion or tool docstring
kaidoku, kengaku, tsukuroi, kama, kasegi had dirty worktrees; findings are stated at committed HEAD blobs
running a sibling gate is not a verdict on that gate's own claim; it was used only as a witness that its rule does not cover C2's class
a sibling round concurrently editing one of these rules is not visible from here
